correctness.rationale: Flat torus difference is Haar-uniform, and the nearest-lattice representative is uniform in its central Voronoi cell C, so F(r)=vol(C∩B_r)/V and F'(r)=r²(4π-U(r))/V. A Voronoi facet plane has foot v/2 in its relative interior, ensuring its spherical cap is born at r=|v|/2 uncovered. Its area 2π(1-a/r) contributes U' right jump 2π/a. Other caps and crossings have continuous exposed-boundary first variations, so F'' jump equals -2πr m(r)/V; covolume from initial r³ coefficient. Opposite facets counted separately. Independent cube case tested six simultaneous facet births at r=1/2, yielding exact jump -6π. Full-dimensional/general coincident critical radii proof examined; no analytic gap found.
